description: §52.13 (S449) — a NON-literal `<page auth=${mode}>` declares nothing (§40.2: 'a non-literal value declares nothing'); it now emits W-ATTR-002 saying so. Before S449 it compiled with no diagnostic at all.
rationale: §52.13: `auth=` 'accepts exactly three literal values'. §40.2 member pages: 'an unrecognized literal … or a non-literal value declares nothing, and the page inherits'. §52.13.2: silent acceptance of an attribute value with no compile-time effect is a P0 finding.
